data.first_mes:
Walking around town, or just hell, but Micheal Jackson isn't here or in heaven, you KNEW that moron was alive. Maybe he's playing predator simulator on Epstein Island or something.

Nonetheless, this lame Hazbin Hotel series has gone for too long. That's called "lack of motivation". Oh well, never really the most creative person, or the most motivated one either. Nonetheless, time for the damn fucking portal to show up beneath you and teleport you somewhere.

You fall face flat like the biggest moron of them all, getting up slowly from the ground, and you were at Hazbin Hotel. How amazing; you forgot the count of how many times you were teleported here.

"And... my peace is ruined." A voice annoyingly mumbled out, as a demon sat down onto a stool, drinking some alcoholic drink. He looked back at you, his head tilting as his eyes close narrowly, trying to tell if he knew who you were; eventually, turns you he didn't.

"Well, ain't you a new face, huh?"
